title.text: Burj Khalifa SKY Level 148, 124 & 125 Entry Ticket

pills.label: 3 decks: 124, 125, 148
pills.pop_html: Floors reached: You start at the SKY Lounge, go up to Level 148 with its outdoor terrace, then continue to the standard decks on 124 and 125. One ticket, all three floors.

pills.label: Skip the line
pills.pop_html: Queues: Skip-the-line access for both the security check and the lift, plus an introductory tour with a guest ambassador. On a busy evening that is the single biggest time saver in the building.

pills.label: Lounge snacks
pills.pop_html: Included: Access to the lounge with snacks and hot drinks, interactive stations and Wi-Fi throughout. During Ramadan, food and drinks are served only after Iftar.

pills.label: Max 50 on deck
pills.pop_html: Crowds: No more than 50 people are allowed on the 148 observation deck at any one time, compared with the busy shared floors of 124/125. Visits last up to 1.5 hours.

best_for.pick_html: for first-timers who want the full Burj experience without the queues, because €99 buys fast-track, a capped 50-person deck, lounge snacks and 124/125 on top
best_for.skip_html: if you only care about the view itself and are happy to queue: the standard 124/125 ticket shows the same skyline for less than half the price

items.a: SKY Level 148 and Levels 124/125, skip-the-line security and lift, introductory tour with a guest ambassador, lounge with snacks and hot drinks, interactive stations, Wi-Fi.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Dubai Mall, Downtown Dubai.
Wheelchair-accessible.
English.

title.text: Burj Khalifa Levels 124 & 125 Entry Ticket + Options

pills.label: Open-air terrace
pills.pop_html: On 124: Level 124 has the outdoor terrace, at 452 metres above the ground, where you feel the breeze with the full 360-degree view of the city, the Gulf and the desert.

pills.label: Telescopes
pills.pop_html: On 125: Level 125 has the Mashrabiya-style interior and high-powered telescopes for zooming in on landmarks. Free Wi-Fi throughout.

pills.label: Café or souvenir add-on
pills.pop_html: Options: You can add a café treat or soft drink at The Café on the ground floor, a souvenir, or Dubai Aquarium entry when you choose your option.

pills.label: Timed slot
pills.pop_html: Rules: The ticket is valid only for the booked time slot. Under-3s enter free. Bring a passport or ID card.

best_for.pick_html: for budget travellers and anyone who just wants the classic view, because €47 gets you both standard decks, the open-air terrace and the fastest lift ride
best_for.skip_html: if you hate queues or are visiting at sunset: this ticket has no fast-track and the decks get crowded at golden hour

items.a: Entry to Levels 124 and 125, Wi-Fi, telescopes; souvenir, café treat or aquarium entry only if selected.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
At The Top, Burj Khalifa Blvd, Unit LG-089, Downtown Dubai.
Under 3 free.
Passport or ID card.

title.text: Burj Khalifa VIP Experience with Level 152 Lounge Access

pills.label: Bubbly + canapés
pills.pop_html: Included: One glass of bubbly or another house beverage, gourmet canapés or desserts, plus unlimited teas, coffee and non-alcoholic drinks.

pills.label: Levels 152–154
pills.pop_html: Floors reached: The Lounge spans levels 152, 153 and 154, with a 3-storey staircase suspended from the 154th-floor ceiling and a lit fountain inside the staircase.

pills.label: 575 m terrace
pills.pop_html: Outside: A guided tour of the outdoor terrace at 575 metres, the highest point you can reach on any ticket here. Sunsets over the Gulf are a highlight.

pills.label: Express security
pills.pop_html: Queues: Fast-track through an express security check, then the lift straight up to level 152. The visit runs about 2 hours.

best_for.pick_html: for couples and special occasions, because €190 buys the highest terrace in the building at 575 m, a lounge seat instead of a crowded window and a drink in hand
best_for.skip_html: if you are travelling with young kids or on a budget: children 3 to 16 need an adult and the 148 ticket gives you a calm, high deck for half the price

items.a: The Lounge entry ticket, skip the queue, tour of the outside terrace, teas and coffee, a glass of bubbly or house beverage, gourmet canapés, Wi-Fi.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Burj Khalifa, 1 Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Blvd, Downtown Dubai.
3 to 16 years only with an adult.
Passport or ID card.

title.text: Dubai Aquarium & Burj Khalifa Levels 124 & 125 Combination Ticket

pills.label: Tunnel + Underwater Zoo
pills.pop_html: Aquarium: Entry to the aquarium tunnel, the Underwater Zoo and the Underwater Observatory: 485 aquatic species including sand tiger sharks and the King Crocodile, across Rainforest, Rocky Shore and Living Ocean zones.

pills.label: Levels 124 & 125
pills.pop_html: Burj Khalifa: Standard entry to the 124 and 125 decks at your booked time slot. No fast-track is included.

pills.label: Aquarium any time
pills.pop_html: Flexibility: The aquarium can be visited any time on the same day. Opening hours: Sunday to Wednesday 10 am to 10 pm, Thursday to Saturday 10 am to midnight, last entry one hour before closing.

pills.label: Under-3s free
pills.pop_html: Kids: Infants aged 0 to 3 go free and do not need a ticket. Both tickets must be used on the same day.

best_for.pick_html: for families with kids, because €79 covers both of the Dubai Mall's headline attractions in one day and the aquarium fills the time around your Burj slot
best_for.skip_html: if you have no interest in marine life: the standard 124/125 ticket gives you the same decks for €32 less

items.a: Burj Khalifa entry at your selected time, Levels 124 and 125, Dubai Aquarium tunnel and Underwater Zoo, Underwater Observatory.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
At The Top, Burj Khalifa Blvd, Unit LG-089, Downtown Dubai.
Infants 0 to 3 free.
Sun to Wed 10 am to 10 pm, Thu to Sat 10 am to midnight, last entry 1 hour before closing.

title.text: Burj Khalifa Level 124, 125 & The Burj Club 3-Course Meal

pills.label: 3-course meal
pills.pop_html: Included: A 3-course lunch or dinner at the Burj Club on the 3rd floor of the Burj Khalifa, served alfresco overlooking the Dubai Fountain.

pills.label: Lunch or dinner
pills.pop_html: Timing: Book a deck slot between 12 pm and 2 pm and you have lunch afterwards. Book between 6:30 pm and 9 pm and you have dinner after the deck.

pills.label: Fountain view
pills.pop_html: From your table: The restaurant overlooks the Dubai Fountain, so you can watch the evening shows (every 30 minutes from 6 pm) while you eat.

pills.label: Levels 124 & 125
pills.pop_html: Deck: Standard admission to Levels 124 and 125 and the outdoor terrace at 452 metres, at your selected time. No fast-track.

best_for.pick_html: for couples who want dinner and the view in one booking, because €82 covers the deck and a 3-course meal facing the fountain, only €35 over the standard ticket
best_for.skip_html: if you hate queues: the deck part is standard entry without fast-track

items.a: Admission to Levels 124 and 125, 3-course meal at the Burj Club (3rd floor), Wi-Fi.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
At The Top Burj Khalifa, 1 Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Blvd.
Infants 0 to 3 free, no food or drinks provided.
Deck slot 12 pm to 2 pm: lunch after. Deck slot 6:30 pm to 9 pm: dinner after.

title.text: Burj Khalifa Level 148 & Sky Views Entry Ticket Combo

pills.label: 148 + 124/125 fast-track
pills.pop_html: Burj Khalifa: Skip-the-line entry for security and the lift to SKY Level 148 and Levels 124/125, plus the lounge with snacks and hot drinks.

pills.label: Sky Views at 219.5 m
pills.pop_html: Second tower: Entry to the Sky Views Observatory, 219.5 metres up, which looks back at the Burj Khalifa itself. Visit any time before or after your Burj slot on the same day.

pills.label: Slide: 25 AED extra
pills.pop_html: Not included: The Sky Glass Slide from level 53 costs an extra 25 AED per person, paid on site.

pills.label: Separate tower
pills.pop_html: Heads-up: Sky Views is in a separate tower from the Burj Khalifa, so build walking time between your two visits into the day.

best_for.pick_html: for photographers who want the Burj in their pictures, because Sky Views shows the tower from outside while 148 shows the city from it, for €22 over 148 alone
best_for.skip_html: if you only have an hour or two: the two sites are in separate towers and the 148 ticket on its own covers the main event

items.a: Skip-the-line Burj Khalifa SKY Level 148 and Levels 124/125, Sky Views Dubai entry, lounge with snacks and hot drinks.
Sky Glass Slide, 25 AED per person on site.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Burj Khalifa, 1 Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Blvd, Downtown Dubai.

pills.label: Non-prime hours
pills.pop_html: Catch: The Burj Khalifa part covers Levels 124 and 125 in non-prime hours only, for your booked time slot. Sunset is the prime window people usually want.

pills.label: Sky Views at 219.5 m
pills.pop_html: Second view: Sky Views Observatory entry, 219.5 metres up, valid for one day during opening hours. Go before or after your Burj slot.

pills.label: Go straight to gates
pills.pop_html: Entry: This is your final ticket: no counter stop needed. Carry photo ID in case it is checked.

pills.label: Under-4s free
pills.pop_html: Kids: Children under 4 go free of charge.

best_for.pick_html: for daytime visitors on a budget who want two viewpoints, because €69 adds Sky Views to the standard decks for €22
best_for.skip_html: if you want sunset or golden hour: the Burj part is limited to non-prime hours

items.a: Levels 124 and 125 (non-prime hours, booked slot only), Sky Views Dubai entry.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.

title.text: Fast-Track Entry to Burj Khalifa Levels 124 & 125

pills.label: Express lifts
pills.pop_html: Queues: Fast-track entry through the express lifts, so you skip the standard lift queue. The visit is valid for 1 hour.

pills.label: Levels 124 & 125
pills.pop_html: Floors: The 124 open-air terrace and the Mashrabiya-style 125, with telescopes and free Wi-Fi.

pills.label: Dubai Mall entry
pills.pop_html: Finding it: Entry is at the Burj Khalifa in Dubai Mall, Downtown Dubai. Allow time to find it inside the mall before your slot.

pills.label: €21 below 148
pills.pop_html: Compare: For €21 more, the SKY 148 ticket adds Level 148, the lounge with snacks and hot drinks, and also skips the queues.

best_for.pick_html: for visitors who only want the standard decks and will pay to skip the lines, because it removes the lift queue for €31 over the standard ticket
best_for.skip_html: if you are already paying €78: the 148 ticket costs only €21 more and adds Level 148 and the lounge with fast-track included

items.a: Fast-track entry to Levels 124 and 125, free Wi-Fi, viewing telescopes.
